body:
Replace the retired public DATA binding route with lexical WITH producers and pure GRAPH bodies. SQL and AQL-text lower through the existing Program, common checker and Stage owners. JSON/YAML machine inputs remain unchanged.

This PR remains Draft: current caller migration, four-Carrier/P2 connections and public Local/HTTPS acceptance are incomplete.

## Fixed source and dependencies

- Submitted HEAD: `fe40b047448efe4ed1b70afc9265c0404564bfe4` (tree `b7ed4c5cd36f43514eff0988a3d3ca70e6461fa0`).
- Base: main; normally adopted main `23697f7430c227327b4b0b3735ad14806eed321a`.
- Common check-only seam #1502 is integrated. INFER/Debug completion is not a prerequisite.
- Normal main merge: `397fedd634e5905b35e81c87b4231696309d1d41`.
- Current product source: `5f80f15531ddb53ff2670da412de6201b3692ea0` (tree `6b24f545a708ff7ef9e43a174f304c7894be54f5`), a pinned formatting-only follower of tested `bbcbec11e8ede3b97422f3760310342dc45027a0`. The submitted follower preserves reports only; neither follower is a separately executed runtime result.

## Changes

- Resolve WITH binders lexically with authored spans; statically check every binding through common typed topology, then retain existing demand and strict publication preparation.
- Remove retired DATA parser/API routing and Graph LABELS property annotations without compatibility fallback. Marker-free and marked MATCH reach the same checked Graph producer.
- Align installed P1 grammar, current specification/profile and generated compilation/document/canonical pins.
- Preserve complete independent old/new Values preimages. Relative to adopted Scalar main, WITH changes query grammar/rule-dependent invocation and Run identities. Scalar main itself changes Values Unit/Program dependencies relative to the previous WITH source; both complete closures are retained separately. Saved Runs are not reinterpreted under the new pin.

- Migrate current Graph-row sources directly to WITH/GRAPH, preserving all 23 normal and 13 refusal fixture obligations and byte-identical JSON controls. Retain old authored source as historical evidence.
- Reject authored range aliases before a Graph-to-Relation bridge with `RangeAliasRequiresRelation`, while retaining producer aliases and ordinary Relation aliases after projection.

- Migrate core constructor/MATCH and shared Relation callers directly to WITH. Preserve all 38 normal, three execution-failure and 25 refusal declarations with independent rows, ordered schemas, Source counts and byte-identical JSON controls. These declarations are not public execution results.

## Executed limited checks

All checks used the existing 60-second/grace5 nonHeavy guard; original failures remain tracked.

- `cd38e9506...`, run-UiYkvi: corrected independent vector Node1/1, SGA closure Node11/11, WITH/Graph and Values caller JS9/9, three read-only freshness checks.
- `bbcbec11e...`, run-qmvtaa: Graph core JS3/3, complete fixture-obligation Node5/5 and shared-request Node1/1. run-Htb2q7 uses the pinned formatter on that new test only.
- `397fedd63...`, run-Ls7ppv: Node2/3; an obsolete assertion equating the adopted Scalar AoA pin with the old WITH closure failed. The next commit separates those complete preimages. Later commands were not reached there.
- One initial sandbox guard preflight failed before any generator/test because process inspection was unavailable. Normal escalated execution was accepted without guard modification; it is not a product or automatic-approval failure.
- All actual Owner/group/worktree locks were observed released. New integration receipts and reproducible exact commands are tracked in `reviews/2026-10-11-with-carrier-cutover/p1-scalar-graph-core-execution.json`.

- `dcd402f4...`, run-Ufj9hv: independent JS17/17 plus five read-only freshness commands. run-T6stAJ: corrected Node2/2, followed by compilation failure before connector JS execution because E-owned `client_check` lacks typed `RangeAliasRequiresRelation` / `BindingPreparation` projection. E handoff is tracked; this caller is not passed.
- `aedb203686...`, run-UamMq8: Node91/93; the two stale current-CID expectations were corrected from independent complete preimages before dcd402. This is not Node93/93 on one source.
- `f3dd115f...`, run-MVeI02: current Graph rows Node5/5 and JS7/7.
- Earlier `6d0f1a378...`, run-Jdvclk: JS29/29, corrected SGA Node11/11 and five read-only freshness commands; actual Owner/group/own-lock release confirmed.
- `4d63461aa...`, run-1uEBN9: Node87/88, including Values61/61, manifests6/6 and profile10/10. The remaining historical SGA-body assertion failed there and was corrected before run-Jdvclk. This is not Node88/88 on the submitted HEAD.
- `f01d05b7...`: JS27/27, including full independent Programs, bare/marked MATCH and retired LABELS routing/position refusals.
- Generator/interface/selected formatter receipts and all earlier failed attempts are retained under `reviews/2026-10-11-with-carrier-cutover/`.
- Reproducible commands: `reviews/2026-10-11-with-carrier-cutover/prepared-checks.json`.

## Remaining finite cutover

- Replace remaining current DATA fixture/caller/tutorial sources directly while preserving independent predicates, limits, rows, types, order and refusal expectations; preserve historical receipts and internal structural fixtures.
- Adopt E's typed diagnostic projection for the new static binding causes; do not convert all binding failures into author blame or disclose hidden Catalog information.
- Complete remaining non-Relation alias/type refusals, four Carrier bindings and adopted SGA/VecA/TEA argument roles.
- Run agreed SQL/AQL-text/README and four-Carrier packed Local/HTTPS cohorts in an allocated Heavy slot, retaining package digests, actual values/schema/refusals, request reuse and resource-release evidence.

No Heavy/package producer, public Host/provider execution, Native/Wasm execution or Hosted CI was started for this unit. Local checks and source-routing tests do not establish public execution or CI success. See the tracked README and execution records for exact source/count boundaries.
